# Vidmark 1.3.1
- Requires authentication before opening local study data or starting Vidmark's local services. - Supports Touch ID or the Mac login password through Apple Local Authentication. - Supports a six-digit app PIN stored as a salted, one-way local verifier. - Adds manual locking, security settings, and automatic locking when the Mac sleeps or the user session locks. - Requires Mac authentication to recover from incomplete or invalid saved security state.

# Vidmark 1.3.0
- Requires authentication before opening local study data or starting Vidmark's local services. - Supports Touch ID or the Mac login password through Apple Local Authentication. - Supports a six-digit app PIN stored as a salted, one-way local verifier. - Adds manual locking, security settings, and automatic locking when the Mac sleeps or the user session locks.

# Vidmark 1.2.0
- Adds secure automatic application updates and a **Check for Updates…** menu command. - Ignores shared-question events when the incoming question is identical to the local version. - Shows exact changed fields when reviewing a shared question update. - Uses Apple Speech for on-device voice-note transcription.
